spans.s:
1 A seat covered with
bark.
--2 N. of an enemy of Viṣṇu.

1 N. of a fabulous
mountain (round which all the planets
are said to revolve; and which
forms the centre of the several
Dvīpas; cf. द्वीप; it is also said to
consist of gold and gems); विभज्य
मेरुर्न यदर्थिसात् कृतः

.
--2 The central bead in a
rosary.
--3 The central gem of a
necklace.
--Comp.
--आद्रिकर्णिका
the earth.
--धामन् m. an epithet
of Śiva.
--पृष्ठं heaven, the sky.
--यंत्रं a figure shaped like a
spindle.
